results.title: Analysis Results
results.reportSubtitle: A personalized assessment of your latest scan.

acne.NONE: Minimal bacterial or inflammatory lesions detected.
acne.MILD: A sparse collection of small lesions confined to the lower face.
acne.MODERATE: Multiple active lesions with mild inflammation in the U-zone.
acne.SEVERE: Widespread inflammatory lesions with nodular structure across multiple zones.

redness.NONE: Even skin tone with no visible vascular dilation.
redness.MILD: Slight vascular dilation observed around central cheek area.
redness.MODERATE: Persistent vascular congestion across the central face.
redness.SEVERE: Diffuse erythema with notable vascular prominence and flushing episodes.

texture.MILD: Minor epidermal roughness present on light-reflective zones.
texture.MODERATE: Irregular texture with visible surface roughness and fine creping.
texture.SEVERE: Pronounced roughness with deep creping and enlarged skin structure.

pigmentation.NONE: Even melanin distribution with negligible photo-damage.
pigmentation.MILD: Faint localized pigmentation with light sun exposure marks.
pigmentation.MODERATE: Clustered hyperpigmentation with darkened patches on exposed skin.
pigmentation.SEVERE: Dense hyperpigmentation covering large continuous surface areas.

dryness.NONE: Well-hydrated surface with intact lipid barrier.
dryness.MILD: Noticeable but minor moisture depletion in exposed regions.
dryness.MODERATE: Noticeable moisture depletion detected along the lateral jawline.
dryness.SEVERE: Severe dehydration with flaking and compromised barrier function.

pore_size.NONE: Pores are compact with minimal follicular dilation.
pore_size.MILD: Slight follicular dilation in the nasal bridge and inner cheek junction.
pore_size.MODERATE: Enlarged pores with visible sebum accumulation across the T-Zone.
pore_size.SEVERE: Severe follicular dilation with obstructed and highly visible pores.
